subject: Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.

messages.author: f7825395596c3639
messages.subject: Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.
parts:
Hi,  I have deployed my application on shiny-server installed on AWS (GNU LInux).   My application deploys properly and when I access port 3838 thus,

http://<aws-dns-name>:3838

I get a list of all the sample applications, including my application.  However, when I click on link for my app, it keeps spinning and after a while comes back with this error,

Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.

messages.author: d7e6eedd96ebd84a
messages.subject: Re: Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.
parts:
Hello,

I've also encountered the same error. There are no other debug statements that I can work with. I have two applications underneath the 'web app' folder, and they each have the correct structure, ie, app_name/{ui.R, server.R}.

Have you been able to resolve this?

Thanks!
Paul

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.
parts: This means that the R process exited before Shiny ever got far enough to start listening for requests. You can write messages to stderr (for example: cat("Got here", file=stderr()) ) and those messages should be written out to the error page as well; if you sprinkle these in your startup code it should help you pinpoint where the failure is occurring.
